tasks.label: Run script regression harnesses
args: Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '${workspaceFolder}\Tests' -Filter 'Test-*.ps1' -File | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "Running $($_.Name)..."; & '${env:windir}\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe' -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $_.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "$($_.Name) failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." } }

tasks.label: Run Pester regression suites
args: Import-Module Pester -RequiredVersion '6.2.0' -ErrorAction Stop; $Tests = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '${workspaceFolder}\Tests' -Filter '*.Tests.ps1' -File | Sort-Object Name); if ($Tests.Count -eq 0) { throw 'No Pester regression suites were found.' }; $Result = Invoke-Pester -Path $Tests.FullName -Output Detailed -PassThru; if ($null -eq $Result -or $Result.Result -ne 'Passed' -or $Result.TotalCount -eq 0 -or $Result.FailedCount -gt 0 -or $Result.FailedContainersCount -gt 0 -or $Result.FailedBlocksCount -gt 0 -or $Result.SkippedCount -gt 0 -or $Result.NotRunCount -gt 0) { throw 'Pester regression suites did not fully pass.' }
